operations.command:
set -e; for unit in generate-sb-keys.service prepare-sb-auto-enroll.service; do for i in $(seq 1 240); do result=$(systemctl show -p Result --value "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$result" = success ]; then break; fi; if [ "$result" = exit-code ]; then systemctl status "$unit"; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; test "$(systemctl show -p Result --value "$unit")" = success; done; verify=$(sbctl verify); printf '%s
' "$verify"; printf '%s
' "$verify" | grep -q '/boot/EFI/BOOT/.* is signed'; printf '%s
' "$verify" | grep -q '/boot/EFI/systemd/.* is signed'; printf '%s
' "$verify" | grep -q '/boot/EFI/Linux/.* is signed'; ! printf '%s
' "$verify" | grep -q '/boot/EFI/BOOT/.* is not signed'; ! printf '%s
' "$verify" | grep -q '/boot/EFI/systemd/.* is not signed'; ! printf '%s
' "$verify" | grep -q '/boot/EFI/Linux/.* is not signed'
